title: Quantifying the Contextualization of Word Representations with Semantic Class Probing
reasoning: The paper uses 'religion-religion' and 'god' as two of 34 semantic classes to test BERT's contextualization capabilities. The purpose is not to evaluate religious concepts or ethical stances but to use words from this domain as a test case for semantic understanding, similar to how it uses classes like 'location' or 'art'.
